prompt: Solve the Sokoban puzzle. Move the agent and push every box onto a target. Boxes cannot be pulled and walls cannot be crossed.

Fill the grid one cell at a time. Start at any colored endpoint and visit every remaining endpoint of that color. Then switch at an endpoint of a new color. Moves are horizontal or vertical, cannot cross or overlap, and every cell must be filled. Keep a single continuous walk across color changes: the next endpoint must be adjacent to the previous filled cell.
